text:
hannah: quick heads-up from mobile QA — on narrow phones (~360px) the action chip stack pushes into the row title when the left nav is collapsed. looks tight on iPhone SE and many Android small devices. screenshot: https://staging.redwood/ss/360-action-stack.png
diego: saw this too. it manifests when we keep the table layout; chips wrap under the title and the row height spikes. also the right-side drawer overlaps the last column at this width.
fae: proposal: switch to stacked two-line rows under 400px: title + meta line where actions float right. keeps chips visible and keeps action hit area large.
sam: CSS idea: 
```@media (max-width:400px){ .row{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:10px} .meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center} .actions{min-width:44px} }```
hannah: we should also avoid edge swipe gestures on narrow widths — users are tripping system back gestures. either move swipe start inward (24px) or disable swipe and show overflow icon.
kai: long-press for actions is another option, but not great for discoverability. I'd prefer explicit overflow icon with aria-label and visible affordance.
diego: copy tweak: change "View details & actions" -> just "Details" on small screens. shorter label prevents wrapping and is screen-reader friendly if we use aria-label="Open details and actions".
fae: accessibility checklist: role=list/role=listitem for the list, ensure overflow button has aria-expanded & aria-controls when it opens the sheet, announce sheet with aria-modal+role=dialog and readable title "Item actions". close must return focus to the triggering control.
sam: for the right-side drawer, on <420 switch to bottom sheet full-width, respect safe-area insets: padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom). Also use focus-trap and set initial focus to first actionable element.
hannah: visual tweak: reduce sheet shadow at OLED (rgba(0,0,0,0.10)) and make close icon 44px. also ensure chevron expandors are at least 48px.
kai: small perf note: prefer CSS-only layout change where possible to avoid heavy remounts in the virtualized list. lazy-mount expanded details on tap.
diego: gesture conflict fix: disable row-swipe if window.innerWidth <= 420 and surface shows touch-capable, then show overflow icon. pseudo: `if (touch && width <= 420) disableRowSwipe()`
fae: UX test idea: 3-person thumb reach test: one-handed left-hold, right-hold, and two-thumb. verify primary actions and close are within easy reach.
design-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood/preview/stacked-actions-1881 — includes stacked rows <400, overflow icon fallback, bottom sheet for drawers, a11y labels.
hannah: action items: sam open a prototype PR with CSS + a11y checklist, kai run thumb reach on Pixel 4a and iPhone SE, diego verify no regressions on foldables, fae run screen-reader pass. aim to ship in next sprint. :thumbsup:
